verdict.summary: The change correctly makes malformed observability trigger-fire rows visible while preserving valid-row publication and keeping diagnostics bounded. Row-drop and evidence-link budgets are independent, close in deterministic order, and use only bounded/sanitized collector text. The self-tests exercise the named regression, distinct malformed shapes, log-injection and oversized-value cases, silence on the accept path, cap boundaries, continued data publication, and both single- and dual-seam flooding with literal expectations, so the assertions are non-vacuous and pin the intended behavior. No trust check, workflow permission, secret-handling path, or fail-closed control is weakened.
